CustomMetadata.label: Case: Set Default Description On Close

values.value: Migrated from the native record-triggered flow Case_Set_Default_Description_On_Close (RecordAfterSave, decision "Check_If_Status_Became_Closed"). Sets Case.Description to a default value when Status transitions to Closed (Status = "Closed" now, was not Closed before). Runs as a Before Update Trigger Action Flow (TA_Case_SetDefaultDescriptionOnClose) so the field write applies without extra DML. The became-Closed condition now lives in Entry_Criteria__c instead of an in-flow Decision element. The original native flow was deactivated (status=Draft), not deleted.
